alert.low_battery: The lights flicker! The battery is low because the sun is down.
alert.battery_empty: Battery empty! Everything switched off. Turn things off so it can recover!
alert.flare: The sky glows! A solar flare's light got here first. Particles are coming. Get everyone to the shelter!
alert.particles: Particles are here! Dosimeters are ticking up.
alert.hungry: Hungry crew get tired! There was not enough food tonight.
alert.message_lost: The message was lost in the static. Send it again when the link is back.
alert.ask_waiting: Your question is still on its way. Light can't go any faster!
earth.reply_malf: Salamat for waiting! We tested it on our copy of your base: it is NOT the %s.
earth.reply_warn: We see it from Earth: %s coming in about %d h %02d min. Get ready. Ingat!
earth.reply_quiet: All quiet from here. Nothing big is coming tonight. Ingat, commander!
signal.label: LIGHT TAKES %d MIN EACH WAY
alert.no_link: No link to Earth. Turn the Comms Dish on, or wait for the static to clear.
alert.ask_earth_reply: Earth replied! But by the time help arrives, you already had to decide on your own.
alert.too_many_cameras: Only 2 cameras can be on. Cameras use power!
alert.door_closed: Shelter door closed. Thick walls block most radiation.
lose.battery.why: The sun was down, so nothing refilled the battery while everything kept using it.
lose.battery.tip: Watch the forecast line. If it says the battery runs out before 06:00, switch something off.
lose.oxygen.why: The crew breathed oxygen faster than Life Support could make it.
lose.oxygen.tip: Keep Life Support on Normal, and turn it up when the air feels heavy.
lose.dose.what: A crewmate got too much radiation.
lose.dose.why: Mars has thin air and no magnetic shield, so solar particles reach the ground.
lose.dose.tip: When the sky glows, open the shelter, call everyone in, and close the door before the particles arrive.
evacuate: Emergency! Everyone is going to the shelter to rest.
forecast.until: At this rate your battery lasts until %s
bonus.shelter_fast: Everyone sheltered within 30 s of the alarm
bonus.discovery_sent: Send the discovery before the blackout
guide.1: The sun has set, so the solar panels make no power. Watch the battery forecast and switch things off to make it last until 06:00!
guide.2: The crew breathe oxygen that Life Support makes, and food carries over to tomorrow. The Crop Lamp grows food, but it uses battery too.
guide.3: Radiation is invisible, so watch the dosimeters. When the sky glows, call everyone into the shelter: its thick walls are shielding.
guide.4: Messages to Earth take minutes to arrive, so the crew must decide for themselves. Turn on the Comms Dish to talk, and recall anyone outside.
guide.5: A dust storm covers the solar panels, so the battery starts lower. Dust and static also make the radio weak.
guide.6: A real solar flare is coming. Its light arrives first, then particles follow about 20 seconds later: get everyone sheltered in time!
guide.7: Dust, a flare and a blackout, all in one night! Send your discovery to Earth early, before the link goes dark.
fault.loose_cable.start: Something is wrong in the Solar Field! Power is leaking. Check the SOLAR camera.
fault.loose_cable.fixed: Cable fixed! The battery stops leaking.
fault.clogged_filter.start: The air feels heavy. Something is wrong in Life Support! Check the AIR camera.
fault.clogged_filter.fixed: Filter cleaned! Life Support makes air again.
fault.airlock_leak.start: A hissing sound from the Airlock! Air is leaking out. Check the AIRLOCK camera.
fault.airlock_leak.fixed: Airlock sealed! No more air leaking.
fault.greenhouse_leak.start: Drip, drip! A water pipe leaks in the Greenhouse. Plants stop growing until you check the PLANTS camera.
fault.greenhouse_leak.fixed: Pipe fixed! The plants can grow again.
fault.shelter_seal.start: The shelter door seal is cracked! Shielding won't work well. Check the SHELTER camera.
fault.shelter_seal.fixed: Seal fixed! The shelter's shielding works again.
crew.go.solar_field: Tara! Going out to check the solar panels!
crew.go.comms_dish: Walking out to the comms dish!
crew.go.outside: Heading outside for a quick job!
crew.go.greenhouse: Off to the greenhouse to water the pechay!
crew.go.life_support: Checking the air machine in Life Support!
crew.go.galley: Kain tayo! Time for a snack in the galley!
crew.to_shelter: On my way to the shelter!
crew.calling: %s is calling from the %s! Open that camera and tap them to answer.
discovery.appeared: Something shiny appeared on the %s camera! Tap it to collect tonight's discovery.
discovery.found: Discovery logged: %s! Ang galing! Read about it at sunrise.
goal.story: A supply ship is flying from Earth and lands in 7 nights. Keep Lani, Maya, Mateo and Carlo safe every night until it arrives!
goal.science: Each night, also find one science discovery on the cameras. Earth wants to learn about Mars!
sponsor.offer: %s is offering to pay %d materials for showing ads at your base tonight.
sponsor.warning: But their messages pop up over your camera monitors! You must tap them closed.
help.battery: This is your battery: the power for the whole base. The sun is down, so nothing refills it tonight.
help.forecast: This tells you when the battery runs out if nothing changes. A sun means it lasts past sunrise: keep it that way!
help.clock: The night goes from 18:00 to 06:00. Keep everyone safe until 06:00 to win.
help.cameras: Turn on up to 2 cameras to see the rooms. Each camera uses power, and problems only show on the right camera.
help.monitors: Tap problems, crew with a '!' and shiny discoveries right on the camera picture.
help.shelter: Open the door to call the crew into the shelter. Close it to protect them with thick walls (shielding).
help.recall: Calls everyone outside back to the airlock. Use it when the sky glows!
help.comms: DISH turns the radio on (uses power). ASK sends a question to Earth. Light needs minutes to get there AND back, so ask early! Earth can rule out a malfunction cause or warn you what is coming. SEND sends your discovery.
help.heater: Keeps the crew warm. OFF saves power but the crew get cold and plants stop growing.
help.life: Makes oxygen for the crew to breathe. OFF saves power, but the air runs out!
help.lamp: Grows food for tomorrow while it is on, but it uses power all night.
help.scroll: The malfunction board. Each bar shows how likely a cause is. Clues and scans change the bars. When you're sure, press DIAGNOSE.
help.meters: Shows tonight's extra meter (air, radiation or radio) and your food.
tut.1: This is your battery. The sun has set, so nothing refills it tonight.
tut.2: This line tells you when the battery will run out. Keep it past sunrise!
tut.3: Cameras show the rooms. Press the SOLAR camera button to turn it on.
tut.4: Every switch uses power. Turn the HEATER down until it says LOW.
tut.5: See? The forecast moved later. Every choice has a cost!
tut.6: A cable came loose in the Solar Field! Tap the sparks on the SOLAR camera, then reconnect the wires.
tut.7: Lani is calling! She is in Life Support: press the AIR camera, then tap Lani to answer.
tut.8: Something shiny is on the SOLAR camera! Tap it to collect tonight's science discovery.
tut.9: Great job, Commander! Now keep everyone safe until 06:00. Press ? on any control for help.
tut.request: Lani: Can I warm up the battery cells? It costs a little power, but I'll find spare parts too!
alert.all_clear: All clear! The particles have passed. Open the shelter door so the crew can go back to work.
crew.back_to_work: All clear! Balik trabaho, back to work!
malf.right: Diagnosis right: %s! The repair crew fixed it.
malf.wrong: Not the %s. The repair trip cost some battery. Look for more clues!
malf.scan_empty: SCAN: nothing unusual here. That makes this room's causes a bit less likely.
fault.panel_dust.start: Dust is clogging the solar field equipment! Power is leaking. Check the SOLAR camera.
fault.panel_dust.fixed: Dust cleaned! Everything runs smoothly again.
fault.dish_drift.start: The dish turned away from Earth! The radio link is weak. Check the SKY camera.
fault.dish_drift.fixed: Dish pointed at Earth again! Strong signal.
challenge.food_grew: Grow food tonight (Crop Lamp on long enough)
challenge.shelter_fast: Everyone sheltered within 30 s of the alarm
challenge.carlo_reply: Carlo inside by sunrise, and a reply from Earth
challenge.discovery_sent: Send the discovery to Earth before the blackout
science.goal: Solve the malfunction AND find the discovery
malf.start: MALFUNCTION: %s Watch the cameras for clues!
tut.10: Something is wrong tonight! The MALFUNCTION board shows the possible causes. Clues make one cause more likely.
tut.11: Press SCAN on the SOLAR camera to look for a clue. Scans cost a little battery.
tut.12: The clue points to the cable! Press DIAGNOSE and pick the most likely cause.
help.stars: 3 stars every night: SURVIVE until 06:00, SCIENCE (solve the malfunction AND find the discovery), and tonight's CHALLENGE.
task.loose_cable.fact: Space plugs have a key, so they only fit one way. No wrong plugs on Mars!
task.panel_dust.fact: Dust storms coat everything on Mars. Opportunity's panels got cleaner thanks to wind!
task.clogged_filter.fact: MOXIE on the Perseverance rover really made oxygen from Mars's CO2 air, at 800 C!
task.airlock_leak.fact: Air pushes out into Mars's thin air. Astronauts find leaks by watching dust drift.
task.greenhouse_leak.fact: Water is precious on Mars. The space station recycles about 98% of its water!
task.shelter_seal.fact: Piling Mars dirt (regolith) on a shelter blocks space radiation.
task.dish_drift.fact: From Mars, Earth looks like a bright evening star. Curiosity took a photo of it!
